newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Senate approves Labor Law reform bill.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Senate approves Labor Law reform bill.

text.p: Venezuela's crucial Labor Law reform drew closer to final approval Wednesday after the Senate approved the bill before passing it for final discussion to the lower chamber, legislators said.

The law, which paves the way for labor market liberalization, is due to be discussed -- and expected to be finally passed -- on Tuesday by the Chamber of Deputies, congressional president Cristobal Fernandez said.
The law "is the beginning of a new labor regime and social security system ... for the country, and I think it's a great advance and triumph," Fernandez said in a closing speech to the Senate.
"All that's missing is for the Deputies to accept or reject the Senate's modifications. I believe there is the will to approve," he added.

The Senate nixed earlier proposals that would have effectively indexed Venezuelan wages to inflation which topped 100 percent in 1996 and is seen at 30 percent this year, according to government targets.
